### The Real Deal
Author: Mary Southerland
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-oct-30-2006-1442436.html
Passage: Psalm 11:7
Points:
- True worship requires genuinely encountering God rather than going through empty religious motions.
- Scripture promises that the upright will see His face, meaning worship takes place in an honest heart.
- Cultural compromises and small dishonesties forfeit authentic spiritual integrity.
- Approaching the Lord in total transparency and confronting personal sin unlocks real fellowship with Him.

### Killing Time
Author: Dr. James Dobson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-devotions-for-parents-by-dr-james-dobson/dr-dobsons-parenting-devotional-july-5.html
Passage: Psalm 11:5
Points:
- God examines both the righteous and the wicked, and His soul hates the lover of violence.
- Modern entertainment and media exposure can gradually desensitize children to cruelty and harm.
- Habitual exposure to brutality threatens both emotional well-being and a child's relationship with God.
- Parents are urged to actively protect their families from violent cultural influences.
